sentences.text: Jastin @ Tamjim Mirdha @ Tanjim Mirdaha, aged about 22 years, Son of Late Ayub Mirdaha,
Resident of Vill.-Hussain Nagar, Gumla P.O. & P.S.-Gumla, Dist.-Gumla
Petitioner -Versus - The State of Jharkhand ... ... Opposite Party ------
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Abhay Kumar Chaturvedy, Advocate For the State : M/s. Rakesh Ranjan,
A.P.P.
-----
02/10.12.2024 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Gumla P.S. Case No. 105/2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 469/2024 and S.T. Case No. 211/2024, for the offences registered under Section 376 of the I.P.C. subsequently chargesheet has been submitted under Section 376(2)
(n) and 120(B) of the I.P.C. and Section 66(C), 67 and 67(A) of the I.T. Act and Section 14 of the Sarai Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I Gumla.

entities.text: Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I Gumla
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the victim, who is a major lady.
It is also alleged that he took her obscene photographs.
4. The occurrence has taken place in the year 2021.
The present case has been instituted after a lapse of two years.

sentences.text: 1 5. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I Gumla in connection with Gumla P.S. Case No. 105/2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 469/2024 and S.T. Case No. 211/2024.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Nandini/-
